title: Aphorism § 19
text:
§ 19



Now, as diseases are nothing more than alterations in the state of
          health of the healthy individual which express themselves by morbid signs, and the cure is
          also only possible by a change to the healthy condition of the state of health of the
          diseased individual, it is very evident that medicines could never cure disease if they
          did not possess the power of altering man's state of health which depends on sensations
          and functions; indeed, that their curative power must be owing solely to this power they
          possess of altering man's state of health.
